ideas.pitch: An augmented reality historical tour guide leveraging local geospatial data and spatial audio to recreate 18th-century Williamsburg scenes for tourists walking the historic area.
ideas.title: Colonial Williamsburg AR Heritage Trail
ideas.why_it_could_win: It directly appeals to local tourism boards and university judges in Williamsburg by turning the historic district into an interactive tech playground.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered environmental monitoring dashboard analyzing open-source satellite and water sensor data to predict and alert local authorities about algal blooms and runoff risks.
ideas.title: James River Watershed Sentinel
ideas.why_it_could_win: It addresses regional ecological concerns specific to Virginia's waterways, making it compelling for sustainability-minded local judges.

ideas.pitch: A hyper-localized peer-to-peer shift-trading and micropayment escrow platform tailored for university dining and campus student workers.
ideas.title: CampusShift Shift-Trading Marketplace
ideas.why_it_could_win: It solves an immediate, painful logistical problem experienced by students and campus employers alike during long semesters.

ideas.pitch: A graph intelligence platform mapping local Virginia farms directly to regional restaurants and grocery co-ops to optimize sustainable supply chains and reduce food waste.
ideas.title: Tidewater Local Food Supply Graph
ideas.why_it_could_win: It plays into the thriving farm-to-table culture of the Mid-Atlantic region, appealing to judges interested in local economic impact.

ideas.pitch: An embeddings-based peer study group and project partner matchmaking app that analyzes syllabus text and past project repositories to form high-synergy student teams.
ideas.title: HacksAI Study Group Matcher
ideas.why_it_could_win: It directly targets the immediate needs of hackathon participants and university students trying to find complementary teammates for classes or competitions.
